howto.name: Upload a .pptx file
howto.text: Drop a PowerPoint presentation up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Each slide becomes one PDF page
howto.text: The text of each text box and placeholder is drawn at its position in Helvetica, using the first run's size (capped at 36 pt) and bold setting. Pictures, tables, charts, SmartArt, backgrounds, colours, and speaker notes are left out; for a visual copy of the slides, use Office to PDF.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: The output preserves slide aspect ratio (16:9 or 4:3 as designed).

faq.a: No. Animations are ignored and every text box on a slide is drawn, including text that would only appear later in the animation.
Speaker notes are not included in the PDF, and there is no option to add them. Export the notes from your presentation software if you need them.
They are left out, poster frame included, because only text is converted. If you have the video file itself, Video to PDF can lay out evenly spaced frames from it.
